column4: If there is one thing I would leave you with, it is this: Keep growing. Keep seeking. Keep walking in faith. The truths outlined in this book are not meant to be read once and set aside; they are meant to be lived out daily. The journey of following Christ is one of continual learning, refining, and transformation. We move from faith to faith, from glory to glory, ever pressing on to know Him more.

column4: You may have questions that remain unanswered. You may feel like you’ve only scratched the surface of these deep and eternal truths. That is a good place to be. The Holy Spirit is your guide, your teacher, and your comforter-He will lead you into all truth as you seek Him.

column4: Let us press on together. Stand firm in sound doctrine, walk boldly in faith, and proclaim the Gospel with confidence. The world desperately needs the light of Christ, and you, equipped with the truth, are called to shine.

column4: Thank you for allowing me to be a part of your journey. My prayer is that you will continue to grow in grace, stand in truth, and be a faithful disciple of Jesus Christ.
